title: 4.8 Days and Time
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Recognize the seven days, today, morning/afternoon/night anchors, and whole-hour times from one to ten in supported routine statements.
grammar_function: Today is + day; on + day; in the morning/afternoon; at night; It is number o'clock. Temporal uses of on/in and new at-night chunk are taught as fixed phrases.
prerequisite: 2.6 numbers 1-10, 4.5 morning anchor, and 4.7 routine simple present.
speaking_outcome: Repeat day names, Today is sentences for the week, three part-of-day phrases, and one whole-hour time sentence.
